thread:
Mira: Quick check — for next week's webinar launch, can we freeze landing URLs so SEO can finalize redirects and schema? Need keyword buckets + internal linking plan.
Sam: Agree. Freeze by EOD Thu works. I'll publish the URL map and canonical column to the doc.
Leo: Running a quick SERP experiment on two title variants today. Will post results; this should inform H2/messaging for the webinar signups.
Dena: For redirects we should use 301s for canonical merges. Also need to preserve UTMs. Suggested rule examples below.
Sam: Redirect rules (snippet):
```text
/source-old-path -> /new-path 301 preserve_utm=true
/product?campaign=* -> /product?campaign=$1 302 preserve_utm=true
```
(we'll format into the redirect manifest)
Mira: Schema question — can we add WebinarEvent JSON-LD + FAQPage markup on the landing? Minimal props: name, startDate, url, organizer, description. Who owns this?
Leo: Dena can own the JSON-LD insertion; I'll add the FAQ Q/As. We'll validate with Rich Results test after staging deploy.
Dena: I'll add JSON-LD by Fri. Also proposing internal linking: 3 contextual links from blog, 1 from docs, update top nav CTAs. Proposed anchors:
- /blog/launch-playbook -> landing
- /docs/integration-guides -> landing
- /case-studies/customers -> landing
Sam: For the benchmark narrative we need a concise hero metric to A/B test in the signup flow — latency reduction vs cost/per-request. Which resonates more with enterprise leads? @Mira thoughts?
Mira: Enterprise buyers lean into SLA/predictability. For lead gen, 'x% latency reduction' tests well — but include cost/perf comparison in follow-up material. Recommend two hero variants.
Leo: I'll wire the two headline variants into the webinar CTA and set up an experiment for week-of launch. Will track conversion by traffic cohort and referral source.
Mira: I'll update the project board and tag #seo #webinar #growth. Can we also ensure canonical headers (rel=canonical) match the redirect plan? Small SEO hazard if they're out of sync.
Dena: Good call. Also need the prioritized keyword list per title variant to map H1/H2. Can someone drop the keyword buckets into the doc?
Sam: On it — dropping the keyword sheet into the shared doc in 15m. Includes primary, secondary, longtail and suggested meta description snippets.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy for landing template scheduled 1718882800 UTC — will run smoke checks post-deploy.
Mira: Great — thanks everyone. Re-sync Tue 09:30 PT for final preflight and to sign off redirects/schema. :thumbsup:
